# Quaternius Ultimate Guns Pack — prototype pistol

Publisher: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimategun.html
Official download: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12V-mHNB6bnW2WzgpJfRBQd-TG4pOO3yx
File: FBX/Pistol_1.fbx (official public file ID 1p_BUZNSwSpZPkDORqMowXqpImA_l2uce).
Downloaded 2026-10-27. Author: Quaternius. License: CC0 1.0 Universal; see License.txt.
FBX SHA256: 4a1f77b488f23e1758a4e9a5289cf076c876e3455a176dc8e0f4abea613aae1d

At the initial pistol import, only this pistol model was included. PrototypePistol.prefab references the original FBX mesh. Its imported orientation is preserved, then rotated 90 degrees around Y and normalized to 0.65 world-unit length. A hand grip and Muzzle point are authored separately. Five embedded material colors are reproduced as project-owned URP Lit materials under Features/Weapon/Models/PrototypePistol. No weapon gameplay controller or animation package code is imported from the model pack.


## Assault rifle addition (2026-10-30)

AssaultRifle_1.fbx is from Quaternius Ultimate Guns Pack, obtained from the publisher's official itch.io distribution (https://quaternius.itch.io/50-lowpoly-guns), archive FBX/AssaultRifle_1.fbx. Publisher page: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimategun.html. CC0; existing License.txt covers this model.
FBX SHA256: a972c9aa37fb15b0905c2f61f8163c45dc98bac63b7c0a17fa5e8f0659b929a5
PrototypeRifle.prefab normalizes the mesh to length1.8 world units, keeps +Z as barrel forward, and authors trigger-hand origin, Muzzle and SupportHandGrip separately. Four colors are reproduced as project-owned URP Lit materials. The shared projectile/combat system remains project code.
